                self.spy_liquidation_order_id = ticket.OrderId
                self.Debug("Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment; liquidating equity.")
            return

        # Never deliberately hold an option into its expiration date.
        if self.held_contract is not None:
            expiry = self._expiry_date(self.held_contract)
            if today >= expiry:
                self.block_entries_date = today

                    self._submit_exit("expiration safeguard")

            expiry = self._expiry_date(self.held_contract)
            prior_trading_day = self._previous_trading_day(expiry)

        previous_fast = self.fast.Current.Value
        previous_slow = self.slow.Current.Value

        # Only actual consolidated bars update these indicators.
        self.fast.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        eligible_time = time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)

                previous_fast <= previous_slow and
                self.fast.Current.Value > self.slow.Current.Value):

            return

        if self.entry_order_id is not None or self.exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        if self._has_option_position():
            return

        if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: SPY has no current Slice price.")
            return

        if not data.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no SPY option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: invalid SPY price.")
            return

        minimum_expiry = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)

        eligible_expiries = sorted({
            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Expiry.date() >= minimum_expiry
        })

        if not eligible_expiries:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no expiration at least seven calendar days away.")
            return

        selected_expiry = eligible_expiries[0]
        minimum_strike = spy_price * 1.01

        candidates = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() == selected_expiry
            and contract.Strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no qualifying call at selected expiration.")
            return

        self.entry_contract = selected.Symbol
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId

        self.Debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol}, expiry {selected_expiry}, "
            f"strike {selected.Strike}."
        )

        if self.exit_order_id is not None or self.entry_fill_price is None:
            return

        if not data.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract):
            return

        quote = data.QuoteBars[self.held_contract]
        if quote.Bid is None or quote.Ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote.Bid.Close
        ask = quote.Ask.Close
        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2
        if midpoint >= self.entry_fill_price * (1 + self.PROFIT_TARGET_PCT):
            self._submit_exit("profit target")

        if not self._has_option_position():
            return

        if self.exit_order_id is not None:
            old_ticket = self.Transactions.GetOrderTicket(self.exit_order_id)
            if old_ticket is not None:
                old_ticket.Cancel("Replacing existing exit order")
            self.exit_order_id = None

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract, -quantity)
        self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Exit submitted ({reason}): {self.held_contract}.")

        if order_event.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
            if (order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled] and
                    order_event.FillQuantity > 0):
                self.held_contract = self.entry_contract
                self.entry_fill_price = order_event.FillPrice
                self.Debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {self.held_contract} at "
                    f"{self.entry_fill_price}."
                )

            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                      OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.entry_order_id = None
                if order_event.Status != OrderStatus.Filled:
                    self.entry_contract = None

        if order_event.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Exit filled: {self.held_contract} at {order_event.FillPrice}.")
                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_contract = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
            elif order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.exit_order_id = None

        if order_event.OrderId == self.spy_liquidation_order_id:
            if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                      OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.spy_liquidation_order_id = None

    def _has_option_position(self) -> bool:
        return (
            self.held_contract is not None and
            self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity != 0
        )

    def _expiry_date(self, symbol) -> object:
        return symbol.ID.Date.date()

    def _previous_trading_day(self, expiry_date):
        candidate = expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)
        exchange_hours = self.Securities[self.spy].Exchange.Hours

        while not exchange_hours.IsDateOpen(candidate):
            candidate -= timedelta(days=1)

        return candidate

            Resolution.Minute,
            fill_forward=False,
            extended_market_hours=False

        self._previous_fast = None

        self._pending_entry_bar_end = None

        self._entry_order_id = None
        self._entry_contract = None

        self._exit_order_id = None
        self._blocked_entry_date = None

            self._process_expiration_safety()
            self._process_time_stop()
            self._process_profit_target(data)

        # The consolidator callback occurs before OnData for this Slice. Only act on
        # the Slice that closed the crossover bar; never queue a missed signal.
        if self._pending_entry_bar_end is not None:

                self._try_enter(data)
            self._pending_entry_bar_end = None

        self._five_minute_closes.append(float(bar.Close))

            return

        closes = list(self._five_minute_closes)
        fast = sum(closes[-5:]) / 5.0
        slow = sum(closes) / 20.0

        is_bullish_cross = (
            self._previous_fast is not None
            and self._previous_slow is not None
            and self._previous_fast <= self._previous_slow
            and fast > slow

        self._previous_fast = fast
        self._previous_slow = slow

        end_time = bar.EndTime
        eligible_time = (
            (end_time.hour == 9 and end_time.minute >= 45)
            or (10 <= end_time.hour <= 13)
            or (end_time.hour == 14 and end_time.minute <= 30)

        if is_bullish_cross and eligible_time:

        if midpoint >= target_price:

            and self.Time.hour == 15
            and self.Time.minute == 45

            return

        if self.Time.date() >= expiry_date:
